current_stage: FPE-R1 Fix6 — remove periodic main-thread diagnostic stalls and hotbar full-graph rebuilds
progress_note: Fix5.1 restored the FPE root and produced decisive runtime performance evidence. The operator reports Tab/inventory opening is smooth, while movement still freezes periodically and rapid hotbar selection still hitches. The FPE HUD measured its own process at only 0.004 ms average / 0.010 ms maximum, while the inherited CH9.6 diagnostic chain reached 195.137 ms maximum with 210 heavy executions and 5683 suppressed calls. This directly identifies the periodic movement hitch as a main-thread diagnostic rebuild rather than GPU/viewmodel cost. Code review also confirmed a second hotbar-specific waste path: canonical inventory.select_hotbar changes only selected_hotbar_index, but accepted CH9.6 handles every projected Item Graph update by converting the entire canonical graph, loading a new replica graph snapshot, refreshing the full inventory UI, synchronizing equipment presentation, repopulating wearable mappings, and refreshing inherited diagnostics. Fix6 leaves accepted CH9.6 untouched. QuaterniusFpeCh9_6Host now suppresses every automatic inherited heavy _refresh_status call; a heavy status refresh is available only as an explicit manual diagnostic. The host classifies canonical projections after removing revision/tick/checksum and selected_hotbar_index metadata. Proven hotbar-metadata-only projections update only selected_hotbar_index, replica revision/checksum and the persistent hotbar; any structural Item Graph difference fails safe to the accepted full CH9.6 projection path. QuaterniusFpeOptimizedLab consumes the host classification signal so hotbar-only updates no longer dirty/rebuild equipment viewmodel state. Structural equipment/item changes still trigger the full dirty path. New gates assert zero automatic heavy HUD executions, hotbar-only classification, structural mutation fallback, optimized scene root, classified projection signal, and inherited CH9.6 network behavior.
